description: Mint a signed Proof-of-Human-Fulfillment (PoHF) credential attesting a real, ID-verified, live human performed an action. Provide sessionId to attest work fulfillment, or memberId to attest that an ID-verified human is behind an account (optionally wallet-bound). This does not establish that the person holds only one account — read sybil_checked in the returned claims before gating one-per-person actions. Counts as one seal against your monthly plan allowance (1,000/month on Free; unlimited for test keys). Returns an ES256 JWT that anyone can verify against the public JWKS — pass it to check_credential. Requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer, or the apiKey argument).

apiKey.description: Optional: pass your key here if your client cannot set the Authorization header.

memberId.description: Member to attest as an ID-verified, live human (personhood path).

wallet.description: Optional EVM address to bind for on-chain isVerifiedHuman() gating (personhood path).

walletSig.description: Optional EIP-191 personal_sign of the wallet challenge.

name: verify_human
title: Verify a human (mint a PoHF credential)
